texts.label: A
fehler: "because the copier on three had jammed again and she needed the code from maintenance" – implausible motivation for going to the chapel
"coat folded beside them like a careful animal" – "them" clashes with the later "his"; the image is mannered
"The kind that comes before fear has decided what shape to take." – explains instead of showing

texts.label: B
fehler: "You were kind to the man in 12" – edges toward a revelation instead of staying open
"Through the chapel's narrow window she could see the back of his head" – a view from the station to the end of the corridor is spatially doubtful
"plain as a coat hook" – a slightly forced comparison
About 300 words, somewhat over the target

texts.label: C
fehler: "The wood was smooth where countless hands had rested." – stock image
The time of 4 a.m. is never named, and the night shift is only implied
The stranger's knowledge of her name barely generates tension; the scene stays flat
"like something he had read off a chart" – weakens the mystery right away

texts.label: D
fehler: "while the clock over the baptismal font turned from four to five" – logic break: she stands there an hour; also clumsy idiom
"Mara heard the chair scrape" – contradicts the pews
"Before you decide I'm one of them." – vague, mystery-mongering
"Her shoes had gone wet somewhere near the nurses' station" – unmotivated detail
"He wore a visitor's lanyard, no badge" – awkwardly compressed
